pattern_explanation: Turkish took the word pasta from French, where it referred to pastry, so in Turkish it came to mean cake. English took its pasta from Italian, where it means noodles. The spelling stayed the same in both languages, but the meanings went in different directions.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word pasta (transliterated pasta) looks exactly like the English word pasta, but in Turkish it means cake, not noodles. For English pasta, Turkish speakers should use the word makarna.
